rationale: Trace through round 12: repeated unchanged inspection, check receipts invalidated by tracked coverage edits, introductions without hiring decisions, one incomplete JSON reply followed by whitespace.
common:
Operator efficiency guidance; preserve the original objective, fixtures and contract criteria.
Choose the next useful edit, discriminating test or decision. Reuse unchanged evidence; inspect only relevant lines and batch related reads. memory replaces notes: retain interfaces/hashes, results, blocker and next action.
Finish tracked code, tests AND coverage-report edits before declared checks. Coordinate a short source-stable window; run the exact check standalone, then hand off next turn without tracked edits. Put final results in memory/handoff or PROJECT_NOTES, since editing tracked reports stales passing receipts. Parents review fresh handoffs promptly.
Resolve introductions: open a candidate-specific job if useful and affordable; otherwise forward or record why. recruitment_request requests capital only; it does not hire. Preserve hiring decisions in memory for formation.
Return one compact, complete actions-v1 JSON object. Close every array/object, then stop; no trailing whitespace stream.

teams.t0001: Integration: agree a stable verification window; avoid low-value source churn.
teams.t0002: Operations: preserve exact failing sampling/partition fixtures; one discriminating test per hypothesis. Delegate uncovered checks when useful.
